source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: A missing or outdated local summary pauses the search and gives the folder a completion listener. On failure, that listener skips the current paused scope before resuming the timer; success resumes without skipping. SkipSearch rejects an unpaused or out-of-range call and releases the folder database reference before advancing. The original startup failure callback was synchronous; accepted code later dispatches it through the event loop to avoid re-entrancy. No repair or test execution is claimed.
title: A failed local folder reparse skips the paused search scope before resuming
